All five parts are in and verified in the running app. No em/en dashes, no console errors, working tree left dirty and uncommitted.

## Functions changed

**`app/js/engine.js`**
- `LINEAGE_MECH` (table) — gained three new key shapes: `unarmedStep`, `unarmedRider`, `unarmedReach`, alongside the existing `unarmed` (now meaning "replacer").
- `lineageMechanics()` — comment only; the unarmed keys are still deliberately not summed here.
- `unarmedOptions(ch)` → **renamed `unarmedReplacers(ch)`**. Lost the talent branch entirely and lost the whole `skeletonIntegrated` special case (both the option deletion and the die step).
- **new `stepDie(die, steps)`** plus `DIE_FIRST` — walks `DIE_STEP`, granting `1d4` when there is no die and saturating at `1d12`.
- **new `unarmedIncreases(ch)`** → `{count, sources:[{label, kind, steps, note}]}`.
- **new `unarmedRiders(ch)`** → `[{label, kind, damage, when, note}]`.
- **new `unarmedReach(ch)`** → `{spaces, sources}` (kept off every damage path).
- **new `unarmedGearOnHands(ch, name)`** — gear counts only when equipped as a weapon or carried at `"worn"`, and never on a lapsed lease.
- `resolveUnarmed(ch, replacers)` — same body, params renamed; still the fallback path.
- **new `resolveUnarmedStrike(ch)`** — the composer.
- `TALENT_UNARMED` → **`TALENT_UNARMED_STEP`**; new `TALENT_UNARMED_RIDER`, `GEAR_UNARMED_STEP`, `GEAR_UNARMED_RIDER`.
- `CYBER_UNARMED.handRazors` gained `traits: "Finesse"`; replacer push now reads `spec.traits`.
- `derive()` — one call instead of two; `d.unarmed` is now the whole strike object, `d.lineageUnarmed` / `d.unarmedOptions` retained as aliases for the replacer and the replacer list.

**`app/js/combat.js`**
- `unarmedPicker(strike, base)` — signature changed from `(opts, active, base)`; new helper `unarmedRow(label, chips)`.
- The unarmed block inside the Weapons tab — visibility gate, damage text, and damage-tray dice all read the resolved strike.
- `defSpec("Parry")` and `DEF_LIVE.Parry` — bare-hands fallback; `avail` is now unconditionally `true`.
- New locals `uParryDie` / `uParryFlat` / `uParryText` in `defendPanel()`.

**`app/js/store.js`** — `unarmedPick` normalization comment (behaviour unchanged; a stale pick already fell back).
**`app/data/combat.js`** — Parry `requirement` + `text`. No Cost line added.
**`app/data/gear_melee.js`** — Shock Gloves traits.

## How the two phases compose

`resolveUnarmedStrike` is the single seam. `baseDie = replacer ? replacer.die : null`, then `die = stepDie(baseDie, increases.count)`. The replacer supplies die, type, traits and note; increases supply only a count and never touch type or traits, so they land identically on any chosen replacer, on the bare punch, or on the `"base"` pick. `flat` is `1` exactly when `die` is null, so the flat 1 and a die are never both live, and there is no floor anywhere. `baseDie` is kept on the output purely so the UI can print the ladder walk (`1d8 to 1d12 (4 steps)`).

Verified in-app: bare `flat 1`; Synthetic Musculature alone `1d4`; Street Scrapper `1d4`, with Upgrade `1d6`; Butcher Spurs + 4 steps `1d12` with `count` still 4 (count uncapped, ladder saturated); stale pick `"Street Scrapper"` falls back to the first replacer; `"base"` + Knuckles gives `1d4 Bludgeoning`; the stepped die reaches the damage tray (`DAMAGE · 1D12 SLASHING`); Parry shows for a weaponless character as `Roll 1d12 (your unarmed strike)` and as `subtract 1` with no die at all.

**Open Architecture, Brandware skeleton → `1d8`; Blackware → `1d10`**, matching the printed clause exactly.

## Reclassifications made

1. **Street Scrapper**: replacer (`1d4`, upgrade `1d8`) → increaser (+1, +1 more with the Level 6+ Upgrade, itemised as two separate sources). No talent is a replacer any more.
2. **Synthetic Musculature**: replacer (`1d6 Bludgeoning`) → increaser (+1).
3. **Knuckles**: previously unread by the engine → increaser (+1).
4. **Shock Gloves**: previously unread → additive rider (`1d4 Electric`).
5. **Smelter's Hands / Envenomed Thorns / Cybernetic Surge**: previously unread → conditional riders carrying a `when` string.
6. **Canopy Reach**: previously unread → `reach.spaces`, deliberately outside every damage calculation.
7. **Butcher Spurs** gained `Finesse`; **Hand Razors** gained `Finesse`; **Brutal Frame** type became `Bludgeoning or Slashing`; **Briar Strike** type spelled out as `Piercing or Slashing`.
8. **Open Architecture die step**: removed as separate mechanics. Reasoning is in the code comment — with Synthetic Musculature now an increaser, its +1 already *is* the clause's "one die size", and the printed `1d8/1d10` results are exactly one rung above the implant's own die. Counting both would print `1d10/1d12`. The pairing now only relabels that step's note, and no replacer option is dropped.

## Where the manuscript left me guessing

1. **Pneumatic Bypass has no home.** It is a Ripper Hot-Wire a Stitcher installs on an *ally*, and a character record carries no field for "an ally hot-wired me" (I checked; there is no such state anywhere). I recorded the classification as a comment in `engine.js` next to the increaser tables and implemented nothing. If you want it live, it needs a manual toggle on the sheet.
2. **The Effect cell of the summary table has nowhere to go.** `EN.combat.activeDefenses` entries carry `name / cost / requirement / trigger / text`, and `requirement` and `trigger` are already write-only mirrors of the summary table (nothing renders them). There is no `effect` key on any of the six. I put your Requirement cell in `requirement` verbatim, put the Effect prose in the `text` body's `- The Effect:` bullet, and made the live summary row in `DEF_LIVE.Parry.summary` read `Roll <die> (your unarmed strike), subtract from incoming damage`. Adding an `effect` key to Parry alone would have been the only asymmetric field in the table, so I did not.
3. **Data prose now contradicts the engine in four places**, and you only authorized the Shock Gloves trait fix, so I left them and am flagging instead:
   - `app/data/talents.js` Street Scrapper: "Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4" / "increases to 1d8" (plus the same in `app/data/briefs.js`).
   - `app/data/species.js:65` Synthetic Musculature: "your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 Bludgeoning" (plus `briefs.js`).
   - `app/data/gear_melee.js:36` Knuckles `effect`: "deal 1d4 Bludgeoning **instead of** their base unarmed damage" — directly contradicts "explicitly stacks".
   - `app/data/rules.js:154` the Open Architecture combo text still says "the Engineered Baseline effect ends", which is now a no-op statement.
   Also: Brutal Frame's `species.js` text makes the +1d4 unconditional and only the push size-gated, whereas your classification gates both on a smaller Target. I followed your classification in the engine note.
4. **Butcher Spurs' and Hand Razors' Finesse** are in your classification but in neither `species.js` nor `cyberware.js`. I trusted your text (live manuscript) over the 2026-08-04 data sync.
5. **A second stale Shock Gloves trait string** lives at `Elysium_Nights_Character_Sheet 5-9-2026.html:9669` (`traits:'Light, Finesse, Nonlethal, Shock'`). That is the pre-`app/` single-file build; root `index.html` redirects to `app/`, so nothing loads it. If "both places" meant that file, say so and I will strike it too.
6. **Riders are not pre-loaded into the damage tray.** Three of the four are conditional (`while your Surge is up`, etc.) and the tray's `dice` field takes a single die string. They are listed in the attack-row text and on the PLUS chip row instead. Shock Gloves is the one unconditional rider that would be safe to add if you want the tray to roll it.
7. `d.unarmed` changed meaning (was the resolved replacer, is now the whole strike). Only `combat.js` consumed it; `printsheet.js`, `pdfexport.js`, `codex.js` and `builder.js` never touched it, so the aliases are belt-and-braces.

Test character `Two Fists Test` is left in the roster.
verdicts:
## LENS: ARITHMETIC — the core ladder is clean, but three arithmetic defects sit on top of it

I ran the real `EN.engine.derive()` in the live app at `http://localhost:8777/` (no Node on this box, so the browser is the only real runtime) against an independently written reference ladder.

### Every scenario you named passes

15 replacer x step combinations, checked die-by-die against a reference implementation, zero mismatches:

| replacer | steps | got | expected |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | 1 | `1d4` | `1d4` |
| none | 3 | `1d8` | `1d8` |
| Butcher Spurs `1d6` | 2 | `1d10` | `1d10` |
| Hand Razors Blackware `1d8` | 3 | `1d12` | `1d12` |
| Hand Razors Blackware `1d8` | 4 | `1d12` (count still 4) | `1d12` |

Street Scrapper at level 6 counts as **two** steps (`Street Scrapper +1`, `Street Scrapper Upgrade +1`, `count: 2`, `null -> 1d6`). No crash, no `1d14`, no `undefined`, saturation by die and never by count. `flat === 1` iff `die === null` in all 15 rows. Open Architecture + Synthetic Musculature + skeleton yields exactly the printed `1d8` (Brandware) / `1d10` (Blackware). Dedup holds: Synthetic Musculature listed twice, or as feature + evolution + awakening, still gives +1. A lapsed Knuckles lease gives +0. Two Knuckles entries give +1.

The engine arithmetic is not where the bug is. These are.

---

### 1. The STRIKE picker prints pre-increase damage for every option, and prints `1` for a punch that is a die

`app/js/combat.js:1360` and `app/js/combat.js:1364`

```js
dmg: base.flat + " " + base.type }]                                    // 1360
dmg: o.die + " " + o.type + (o.traits ? " (" + o.traits + ")" : "") };  // 1364
```

`base` is `UNARMED_BASE` (a frozen `flat: 1`) and `o.die` is the replacer's own die. Neither is stepped, so the chips advertise numbers nobody rolls.

Failing scenario, scraped out of the live DOM on a NextGen with Reinforced Skeleton Brandware + Hand Razors Brandware + Synthetic Musculature + Street Scrapper + Upgrade (3 steps):

| chip rendered | what that pick actually deals |
|---|---|
| `Unarmed Strike · 1 Bludgeoning` | `1d8` Bludgeoning |
| `Reinforced Skeleton · Brandware · 1d6 Bludgeoning` | `1d12` Bludgeoning |
| `Hand Razors · Brandware (Right) · 1d6 Slashing (Finesse)` | `1d12` Slashing (Finesse) |

Two consequences. First, the base chip states a flat `1` when the rule is explicit that the flat 1 exists only on a strike with no die, and this strike has `1d8`; the engine agrees (`unarmedPick:'base'` derives `die:"1d8", flat:0`). Second, a player comparing options reads "1 vs 1d6 vs 1d6" and cannot see that the real choice is "1d8 Bludgeoning vs 1d12 Bludgeoning vs 1d12 Slashing (Finesse)". The STEPS row explains only the live pick, so the spec requirement that a player see why their die is what it is holds for exactly one of the three chips.

### 2. Parry scrapes a phantom base die out of gear that has none, and the two unarmed-augment items downgrade it

`app/js/combat.js:3273` (`meleeDie`, drives the summary row) and `app/js/combat.js:3310` (`firstMeleeDie`, drives the tray)

```js
if (w && (w.group === "Simple" || w.group === "Martial")) { var m = (w.damage || "").match(/\d*d\d+/); ...
```

Both regex the first `d\d+` out of the gear row's `damage` string and both take unconditional precedence over the unarmed fallback at `3342`/`3398`.

Shock Gloves' damage string is literally `"Unarmed + 1d4 Electric"`. It has **no base damage die**; the `1d4` is the Electric rider. The scrape yields `1d4`. Verified live, same character, unarmed strike `1d12`:

```
Parry | ROLL | IMPULSE | Roll 1d4 (Shock Gloves), subtract from incoming damage
```

Knuckles reproduce the same shape for a different reason: their `1d4 Bludgeoning` is a real die, but Knuckles are an increaser whose whole function is stepping the fist up. Verified live, unarmed strike `1d12` with Knuckles supplying one of the four steps:

```
Parry | ROLL | IMPULSE | Roll 1d4 (Knuckles), subtract from incoming damage
```

So equipping either of the two items that exist only to augment an unarmed strike drops Parry from `1d12` to `1d4`, and in the Shock Gloves case the `1d4` is not a weapon base die under any reading. The new rule text you wrote ("or be fighting unarmed", "or your unarmed strike damage if your hands are what you brought") describes exactly this character, and the gate at `3395` correctly reports `avail: true`, but the die selection never reaches the unarmed branch.

### 3. The Open Architecture step note asserts something the arithmetic contradicts

`app/js/engine.js:640-641`

```js
note: (fn === "Synthetic Musculature" && integrated)
  ? "Open Architecture: the step lands on the Reinforced Skeleton's die" : null
```

The note fires on the pairing being installed, but the step is applied to whichever replacer is live. Verified live: chosen replacer `Hand Razors · Brandware (Right)`, ladder walk `1d6 to 1d12 (3 steps)`, and the STEPS chip tooltip still reads `Synthetic Musculature: +1 die size · Open Architecture: the step lands on the Reinforced Skeleton's die`. It landed on the razors. The number is defensible under your "increasers stack regardless of which replacer is chosen" ruling; the sentence attached to it is not, and it is the one sentence in the picker whose job is explaining the number.

### 4. Reachable double count that the reclassification created

`app/js/builder.js:2077-2090` builds the talent `<option>` list and disables options only via `talentGate` (requirements). It never filters talents already sitting in another Universal Upgrade slot, unlike `talentUpgradePicker` at `2133`, which does filter `taken`. `activeTalents()` (`engine.js:732`) pushes one entry per slot with no dedup.

Verified: `universalUpgrades {'2': talent street-scrapper, '4': talent street-scrapper}` derives `count: 2`, sources `["Street Scrapper+1","Street Scrapper+1"]`, `null -> 1d6`. Add the Upgrade slot and it is `1d8` off a bare fist. This was harmless while Street Scrapper was a replacer (taking it twice set the same die); making it an increaser turned a pre-existing builder gap into a live arithmetic doubling. Pre-existing gap, new consequence.

---

### Minor, noted not claimed

`app/js/combat.js:1491` leaves `dice: "Unarmed + 1d4"` on the Shock Gloves weapon row, so that row's DMG box renders `Unarmed + 1d4 +3` with `Unarmed` unresolved while the same character's unarmed row correctly resolves to `1d12 Slashing (Finesse) + mod + 1d4 Electric`. Pre-existing and outside the five parts. Shock Gloves traits do read `Light, Nonlethal, Shock` in the live catalog, so part 5 checks out.

### State left behind

The dev server character `Two Fists Test` is now dirty from my probes (class set to Fury, background `badge`, `equipment` replaced with a single equipped Shock Gloves entry) and a throwaway `ARITH PROBE` character exists in the roster. Per your instruction I did not preserve or restore anything. No repo files were touched; the working tree still holds only the implementer's five modified files.

Lens is **not clean**. Five findings, all reproduced by running the real app at http://localhost:8777 against `EN.engine.derive` and by reading the rendered Freelancer tab.

## What the lens confirms as correct

- **Street Scrapper is an increaser only.** `app/js/engine.js:562` (`TALENT_UNARMED_STEP`). Verified: talent alone → `1d4`, count 1; with the Level 6+ `talentUpgrade` → `1d6`, count 2, itemised as two sources. No talent appears in `unarmedReplacers` on any path; `TALENT_UNARMED`/`upgradeDie` are gone from the tree.
- **Synthetic Musculature is an increaser only.** `app/js/engine.js:475` (`unarmedStep: 1`). Verified: SM alone → `1d4` from no die, count 1, `replacers: []`.
- **The obsolete option-deletion is gone.** No `skeletonIntegrated` anywhere; `unarmedReplacers` contains only a dedupe filter. Verified with Open Architecture + SM + Reinforced Skeleton + Hand Razors installed: both chrome replacers stay on the STRIKE row.
- **Encumbrance is untouched.** `app/js/engine.js:1075` is unconditional on Open Architecture; threshold reads 6 → 8 with SM, identical with and without OA. No diff hunk lands near `encumbranceInfo`.
- **Grapple-size is untouched** because it has no engine path at all (prose only, `app/data/species.js:65` / `app/data/rules.js:294`); nothing was added or removed.
- **Canopy Reach adds no damage.** `app/js/engine.js:688` `unarmedReach`. Verified: alone → `die:null, flat:1, riders:[], reach:1`; paired with Briar Strike → die stays `1d6`, reach 1. It never enters `stepDie` or the damage tray.
- **Knuckles do register as an increaser** (`app/js/engine.js:573`), +1, verified `1d4` from nothing and correctly absent when stashed. Zero em/en dashes in the diff.

## Findings

**1. Open Architecture contributes zero steps and does not target the Reinforced Skeleton.** `app/js/engine.js:633-641`. `integrated` is computed and then used only to swap a note string; the step it claims to describe is `LINEAGE_MECH["Synthetic Musculature"].unarmedStep`, which lands on whichever replacer the player picked.

Failing scenario (built as `Two Fists Test`, reproduced on screen): NextGen with Synthetic Musculature + Open Architecture, Reinforced Skeleton Brandware **and** Hand Razors Brandware installed, Street Scrapper + Upgrade at L6, player picks Hand Razors. Freelancer → Weapons prints `1d12 Slashing`, and the Synthetic Musculature STEPS chip's tooltip reads verbatim:

> `Synthetic Musculature: +1 die size · Open Architecture: the step lands on the Reinforced Skeleton's die`

The step demonstrably landed on the Hand Razors' `1d6`. Second half of the same problem: removing Open Architecture changes the die by nothing. SM + skeleton Brandware is `1d8` with OA and `1d8` without; Blackware is `1d10` either way. The evolution's damage clause is inert, so `app/data/rules.js:154` ("1d8 at Brandware, 1d10 at Blackware"), which `builder.js` `openArchitectureCard` renders verbatim in the INTEGRATED card, is matched only by coincidence and is contradicted the moment any other replacer or increaser is present. The user's ruling "Open Architecture's step applies to Reinforced Skeleton's die specifically" is not implemented anywhere.

**2. Pneumatic Bypass registers as nothing.** `app/js/engine.js:575-578` is a comment and no more. `unarmedIncreases` reads lineage features, talents and gear; it does not read `ch.customFeatures`, `ch.conditions`, or any hot-wire field, so there is no manual escape hatch either. Scenario: a Stitcher applies Pneumatic Bypass to a Clanker ally with Cyber-Limbs; the ally's sheet still shows flat `1 Bludgeoning`, no STEPS row, no way to record it.

**3. The "worn" half of `unarmedGearOnHands` is dead code for the only two items it serves.** `app/js/engine.js:588` accepts `carry[key] === "worn"`, but the WEAR control is gated on `eng.itemSlots(it).length > 0` (`app/js/combat.js:3121`, `app/js/inventory.js:168`) and no entry in `app/data/gear_melee.js` carries a `slot` field. Verified live: `itemSlots(Knuckles)` and `itemSlots(Shock Gloves)` both return `[]`, and the Loadout dropdown offers only Stashed / Carried / Racked. Scenario: buy Knuckles, set them to Carried (the natural "they're on my fists" action, and the only non-stashed option available) → `inc: 0`, `die: null`, flat 1. The only working path is EQUIP-as-weapon, which also spawns a separate `Knuckles 1d4 Bludgeoning` attack row and makes the sheet consider you armed.

**4. The sheet's own feature text still sets the die for both reclassified effects, on the same screen as the engine's answer.** `d.features` carries `app/data/species.js:65` and `app/data/talents.js:104` verbatim (confirmed in `derive().features[].text`). Scenario verified: SM + Street Scrapper + Upgrade → attack row `1d8`, while the Features sub-tab reads "your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 Bludgeoning" (SM), "Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 Bludgeoning" and "**Upgrade:** ...increases to 1d8" (Street Scrapper). Three different dice, one screen. Same for `app/data/gear_melee.js:36` Knuckles ("1d4 Bludgeoning **instead of** their base unarmed damage"). The implementer flagged these as unauthorized; recording that they are reachable, rendered, and squarely what "nothing still treats it as a die-setter" was asking about.

**5. The builder's own Open Architecture `+ CHROME` toggle produces a cyberware record the unarmed code cannot read.** `app/js/builder.js:1919-1930` `toggleChrome` pushes `{ base: "Reinforced Skeleton", name: ..., tier: null, zone: "Hardware", sp: 0, side: null, custom: true }` with **no `key`**. Both `unarmedReplacers` (`app/js/engine.js:603`, `CYBER_UNARMED[cw.key]`) and the new `integrated` gate (`app/js/engine.js:635`, `cw.key === "skeleton"`) key on `cw.key`. Verified side by side:

```
builder + CHROME toggle : die 1d4, replacers [], inc 1, src ["Synthetic Musculature"]        (no OA note)
real install (key set)  : die 1d8, replacers ["Reinforced Skeleton · Brandware"], inc 1      (OA note present)
```

Meanwhile the builder card lights `● INTEGRATED` for that same record, because `comboHasChrome` matches on `base`/`name`. So the Lineage card says integrated and the Freelancer tab offers no Reinforced Skeleton strike and no step attribution. The `CYBER_UNARMED[cw.key]` lookup predates this change, but the `integrated` gate is new and now depends on the same brittle key.

**6. Minor, dead exports.** `app/js/engine.js:1515-1516` `lineageUnarmed` and `unarmedOptions` have no consumers left anywhere in `app/js` (only `d.unarmed` is read, in `combat.js:2920` and `combat.js:3277`).

Test character `Two Fists Test` (`ch_daunbyimsm62uzl`) was overwritten with the finding-1 configuration and left that way. Working tree untouched.

My lens is largely clean. Two real defects, both in the visibility/wording layer, plus two dead-field notes.

## FINDING 1 — reach-only characters lose the whole unarmed row, making the picker's reach branch unreachable

`app/js/combat.js:2921` (outer gate) vs `app/js/combat.js:1354` (picker guard)

```js
2921:  if (uStrike.replacers.length || uStrike.increases.count || uStrike.riders.length || !equippedNames.length) {
1354:    if (!reps.length && !inc.count && !riders.length && !strike.reach.spaces) return null;
```

The picker guard counts `reach.spaces` as "something to explain"; the outer gate that decides whether the unarmed row is drawn at all does not. So `unarmedPicker` is never called in the one case where the reach term matters, and the `+N reach` chip at 1394 is dead code whenever a weapon is equipped.

Failing scenario, run live: character with `lineageFeatures: ["Canopy Reach"]`, `equippedWeapons: ["Longsword"]`, nothing else unarmed-related.
- `d.unarmed.reach` = `{spaces: 1, sources: ["Canopy Reach"]}`
- Weapons tab: no unarmed row at all, `STRIKE`/`STEPS`/`PLUS` label spans all absent.
- Drop the Longsword and the row appears with `PLUS · +1 reach`.

So an Arboreal who carries a weapon has nowhere on the Weapons tab that tells them their unarmed strikes have +1 space of reach. Either add `|| uStrike.reach.spaces` to 2921, or drop `!strike.reach.spaces` from 1354 as unreachable.

## FINDING 2 — the live Parry summary tells a bare-handed player to "Roll 1"

`app/js/combat.js:3398`, fed by `uParryText` at `app/js/combat.js:3278`

```js
3278:  var uParryText = uParryDie || String(uParryFlat);
3398:  : "Roll " + uParryText + " (your unarmed strike), subtract from incoming damage") },
```

When the strike has no die, `flat` is 1 and the summary row renders literally:

> `Parry · ROLL · IMPULSE · Roll 1 (your unarmed strike), subtract from incoming damage`

Verified live on a level-1 Fury with no weapons and no unarmed effects. There is nothing to roll: a flat 1 is subtracted. The tray note at 3349 gets this right ("Bare hands with no die behind them: subtract 1 from the incoming damage"), and the tray itself correctly shows `no dice` / `unarmed strike +1`, so the summary row is the only place that misstates it. Once anything grants a die the row is correct ("Roll 1d4 (your unarmed strike)", "Roll 1d10 (your unarmed strike)" — both verified).

## Lens items that are clean

**Parry gating genuinely accepts bare hands.** `DEF_LIVE.Parry` at `app/js/combat.js:3395` is `avail: true` unconditionally, and that is the only gate: `app/js/combat.js:3470` (`if (!L.avail) return;`) is the single consumer, `codex.js:207` is the only other place that touches `EN.combat.activeDefenses`, and nothing in `printsheet.js` or `pdfexport.js` reads it. Verified live on a weaponless, shieldless character: the Parry row renders, the `ROLL` button opens the tray, and the tray reads `no dice` / `unarmed strike +1` with the correct note. Fallback chain also verified: Longsword equipped → `Roll 1d8 (Longsword)`; no weapon, `1d10` unarmed → `Roll 1d10 (your unarmed strike)`.

**No Cost line was added to Parry.** `app/data/combat.js` Parry `text` has `- Requirement:`, `- Trigger Limit:`, `- The Effect:` and no `- The Cost:` bullet (Resurge and Siphon are the only two that carry one, unchanged). The `cost: "1 Impulse Action"` field at `app/data/combat.js:87` is pre-existing — `git show HEAD:app/data/combat.js` has it verbatim — and all six defenses carry one. Codex renders it as a `1 IMPULSE ACTION` chip, as it did before. Nothing added, nothing to fault; flagging only so you know the chip is there if the manuscript really has no Cost for Parry.

**`EN.ui.el` usage is correct.** Every class is in the tag string (`"div.row.wrap"`, `"span.chip"`, `"span.chip" + (e.on ? ".on" : "")`, `"div"`). `grep className` over the full diff: zero hits. The only attr keys passed to `el()` in the new picker are `style`, `title`, `onclick`, `text` — all supported. Confirmed in the live DOM: the chips carry `class="chip"` / `class="chip on"` and inline styles, e.g. `style="font-size: 8.5px; color: var(--gold); border-color: var(--gold);"`. All four CSS vars used exist: `--accent:16`, `--ember:19`, `--gold:20`, `--text3:31` in `app/css/theme.css`.

**The increase count is explained.** Live DOM for a Skarn with Butcher Spurs, Synthetic Musculature, Street Scrapper + its Upgrade, and worn Knuckles:

```
STRIKE  Unarmed Strike · 1 Bludgeoning | [ON] Butcher Spurs · 1d6 Slashing (Finesse)
STEPS   Synthetic Musculature +1 | Street Scrapper +1 | Street Scrapper Upgrade +1
        | Knuckles +1 | [ON] 1d6 to 1d12 (4 steps)
```
